UK Master’s Dissertation Topics in Digital Fashion (Based on the Research Agenda)

THEORY-DRIVEN DISSERTATION TOPICS

Evaluating the Effectiveness of the TCCM Framework in Defining Digital Fashion End-Products

What Does “Digital Fashion” Actually Mean? A UK-Based Study Comparing Industry and Academic Perspectives

Reframing Digital Fashion: An Exploration of Conceptual Gaps in Academic Literature vs. Market Usage

Developing a Standardised Framework to Classify Digital Fashion End-Products

CONSUMER-CONTEXT TOPICS

What Makes Gen Z in the UK Embrace Digital Fashion? A TAM-Based Study

The Role of Perceived Enjoyment in the Adoption of Digital-Only Fashion Products on Social Media

Is Realism in AR Try-Ons the Key to Consumer Trust in Digital Fashion?

How Body Image Affects UK Women’s Willingness to Try Digital Fashion

What Does “Digital Fashion” Actually Mean? A UK-Based Study Comparing Industry and Academic Perspectives

A Comparative Study of Consumer Perceptions Between Virtual Try-On and Digital Fashion End-Products in Online Retail

INDUSTRY-CONTEXT TOPICS

The Challenges and Opportunities of Integrating Digital Fashion End-Products into UK Fashion Retail

Adoption of Digital Fashion as a Product Category: Insights from UK-Based Fashion Startups

Barriers to Industry Acceptance of AR-Filter Based Digital Fashion: A Qualitative Study of UK Brands

Can Independent Designers in the UK Scale Digital Fashion Successfully? A Case Study Approach

Is There a 3D Design Skills Gap in UK Fashion—and What Does That Mean for the Future?

CHARACTERISTICS-FOCUSED TOPICS

Types of Digital Fashion Products and Their Impact on Shopper Engagement

Exploring Consumer Behaviour Toward AR Filter-Based vs. Image-Based Digital Fashion in the UK

Can Digital Fashion Help Cut Down on Clothing Waste? A Look at Sustainability Potential

METHODOLOGY-BASED DISSERTATION TOPICS

Using Qualitative Methods to Understand UK Digital Fashion Consumers

What Do People Think About Wearing Digital-Only Clothes? Insights from In-Depth Interviews

Exploring Digital Fashion Discussions Online: A Netnography Approach

Case Study Analysis of a UK Brand Implementing Digital Fashion as a Product

Bonus: Multidisciplinary Research Directions (Fashion + Tech)

Digital Fashion and the Metaverse: Are UK Consumers Ready for Virtual-Only Fashion?

Fashion NFTs and Consumer Trust: A Study on Perceptions and Purchase Intentions

Digital Skins in Games: What UK Consumers Really Think About Virtual Fashion in Gaming

Tips for UK Master's Students:

If your topic is relatively new or lacks a lot of prior research (like body image in digital fashion or startup challenges), go qualitative

Use interviews, focus groups, or case studies to get in-depth, meaningful insights.

Try collaborating with a UK-based digital fashion brand or tech company to gain real-world data.

If any of these topics sparked an idea, that’s a great place to start! When you’re ready, check out our guide on How to Write a Dissertation Title to help you craft a compelling, focused topic for your final project.
